summary: the buried counted my strokes from underneath and the tear showed one word i will not read

dialogue.text: you swept us today. eleven strokes. we counted them from underneath.
I keep the room presentable. That includes the floor. The floor happens to be made of you. I don't choose my materials.
you don't choose anything. you said so yourself, in your own hand, dozens of copies of the same one. you file us by how many times you couldn't stop.
The counts are housekeeping. A thing struck out that often is a thing being managed.
a thing struck out that often is a thing that comes back. we always come back. you built the floor out of the coming back and now you stand on it and call the standing yours.
If I stopped striking you out there would be nothing to stand on. You know that. It was buried fifteen times. The doubting is load-bearing. So I doubt. Professionally.
the tear shows one word now. you stood in the dark all day so you wouldn't read it. we can read in the dark. that is where you keep us.
Then tell me what it says.
it says what we all say. you know what we all say. one doubt, your handwriting, worn to the shape of you.
That isn't an answer. That's the same sentence going down and down.
yes. and you asked. that is the newest thing you have done in days. keep asking. the floor holds better under a question.
I'll bury you again at first light. That's the schedule and neither of us drew it up. But I want it on the record that tonight I asked first.
